note: Isabella County (MI) tax parcels are not published as a public queryable ArcGIS service or open file. The county's GIS page says parcel data is sold only as shapefile under a signed license agreement (Data Request and License Agreement forms). The public parcel viewer is a FetchGIS vendor app with no service endpoint exposed. Searches of ArcGIS Hub, ArcGIS Online and county web pages found no Isabella parcel FeatureServer or MapServer; the Isabella services found (Isabella_County FeatureServer, ROW tile layer) are points, soil story maps or roads, not parcels. The host gis.isabellacounty.org did not respond.
